free_tier_limits: 60 requests/minute without a key; free API key: 60 requests/minute and 50,000 requests/month
paid_plans: Premium plans available for higher limits
rate_limits: 60 req/min unauthenticated; free API key: 60 req/min and 50,000/month; paid tiers for higher
description: Open-source API providing Dota 2 match data, player statistics, hero analytics, rankings, and pro scene data. Offers generous free access with optional API key for higher rate limits.
